chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Salih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Neglecting the evening meal is a sin, and it is befitting for a man when he becomes aged that he does not sleep unless his stomach is filled with food.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on neglecting the evening meal in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the neglect of the evening meal to 'mahramah' (loss of dignity or strength), emphasizing its role in preserving physical vitality. It specifically advises elderly men to avoid sleeping with an empty stomach, reflecting the Shia scholarly tradition of viewing proper nutrition as a means to maintain the body as an amanah (trust) from God.
